title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 29
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 29: Hezekiah reopens and cleanses Yahweh's house and restores its offerings and worship.

questions.explanation: Hezekiah's mother's name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

questions.text: What did Hezekiah do in the first month of the first year of his reign?
questions.explanation: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of Yahweh's house, and repaired them.

answers.text: He went to war against the king of Assyria
He opened the doors of Yahweh's house and repaired them
He built a new palace for himself in Jerusalem
He held a census of all the men of Judah

questions.text: What did Hezekiah say was in his heart to make with Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah said, "Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with Yahweh, the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us."

questions.text: Where did the Levites carry the uncleanness taken out of Yahweh's temple?
questions.explanation: The priests brought the uncleanness into the court, and the Levites took it from there to carry it out to the brook Kidron.

answers.text: To the valley of the son of Hinnom

questions.text: On which day of the first month did they finish sanctifying Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: They began on the first day of the first month, sanctified Yahweh's house in eight days, and finished on the sixteenth day of the first month.

questions.text: What animals did they bring, seven of each, for a sin offering?
questions.explanation: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats for a sin offering for the kingdom, the sanctuary, and Judah.

answers.text: Bulls, rams, lambs and male goats

questions.text: Besides David, whose commandment did Hezekiah follow in setting the Levites with instruments?
questions.explanation: He set the Levites with cymbals, stringed instruments and harps, according to the commandment of David, of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet.

answers.text: Gad the king's seer and Nathan the prophet
Elijah the prophet and Elisha his servant
Isaiah the son of Amoz and Micaiah
Samuel the seer and Jehoiada the priest

questions.text: With whose words did the Levites sing praises, besides the words of David?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises to Yahweh with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer.

questions.text: Why did the Levites help the priests with the burnt offerings?
questions.explanation: The priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings, so their brothers the Levites helped them.

answers.text: The priests had been sent away to Samaria
The king had forbidden the priests to work
The priests were too few to skin all the burnt offerings
The priests were too old to lift the animals

questions.text: Why did Hezekiah and all the people rejoice at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: They rejoiced because of what God had prepared for the people, for the thing was done suddenly.

answers.text: Because of what God had prepared for the people
Because rain had ended a famine
Because a son was born to the king
